children: Transportation & Logistics Systems entered into a Fourth Amendment to its Member Interest and Asset Exchange Agreement to acquire 80% of Patriot Glass Solutions and four nanotechnology patents for $4.75 million in Series J preferred stock. The amendment extends key diligence and financial statement delivery deadlines to September 25, 2026 and pushes the outside closing date to October 1, 2026. Consideration will be 47,500 Series J Senior Convertible Preferred shares ($100 stated value each). The deal remains subject to audited financials, satisfactory due diligence, landlord consent, and other customary closing conditions; the remaining 20% of PGS will be retained by Michael Wanke.
